title: Web Feature Boundary Reshape
problem: Copied v0 product components still live in one broad components/nako directory, obscuring ownership and making later route/API refactors risky.
evidence: WFBR-010 activated after WTRC closed with test/check/build/diff gates passing.
WFBR-020 moved the Media surface and current internal product pages under web/src/features/media and passed check/test/build plus DTO boundary grep.
WFBR-030 moved the Admin surface, admin child pages, and transcode settings under web/src/features/admin and passed check/test/build plus DTO boundary grep.

continue_policy.notes: Complete feature boundary reshaping before route-owned product surface extraction.
